blocks.text: Netflix will cut about 1,000 jobs, or 6 percent of its workforce, US media reported Wednesday, Oct. 14, as the streaming platform experiences slower growth. When contacted by AFP, the company did not immediately respond. “Our mission — to entertain the world — is ambitious, and delivering on it requires us to be disciplined about where we prioritize our people and resources,” co-CEOs Ted Sarandos and Greg Peters wrote in an internal memo, according to several US media outlets.
